title: CI: zig build test stalls 25min+ on ubuntu-latest after ISS-0134 libc-linking (job-count oversubscription)
registered_by: Found while resolving ISS-0135 (#433) — PR #435's CI run stalled 25+ minutes in zig build test, blocking merge
scope: CI only (.github/workflows/ci.yml). No source code defect; ISS-0134's Environ portability fix itself is correct.
symptom: zig build test in the Build and unit tests CI job stalled indefinitely (25+ min, zero progress) on both the main push run triggered by PR #434's merge and PR #435's own CI run. Last known-good run (pre-#434) completed zig build test in 21s.
root_cause_analysis: PR #434 (ISS-0134) added .link_libc = true to the modules underlying most of the 86 b.addTest targets in build.zig, so zig build test now spawns ~86 concurrent 'zig test -lc' compile+link subprocesses instead of mostly libc-free ones. Zig's default build-job parallelism derives from the visible CPU count, which on a cgroup-quota-limited runner can badly over-report versus the real quota (reproduced locally: nproc reports 16 in a container capped to a 2-core cgroup quota). Reproduced the stall locally (90s+ vs ~20-40s baseline) under that mismatch using Docker with a matching CPU quota; -j2 eliminated it across repeated trials.
resolution: Capped all three zig build invocations in .github/workflows/ci.yml's build job (zig build, zig build test, zig build test-transition) to -j2. Verified locally: cold-cache zig build test -j2 completes in ~80s (one-time, not a hang); warm-cache runs complete in 3-40s consistently across 4+ trials with no stalls.
acceptance_criteria: zig build test -j2 completes reliably without multi-minute stalls
Real GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest run confirms the fix
acceptance_criteria_status: Both verified. PR #435's CI run 31001126327 completed Build and unit tests in 1m0s (vs. 25+ min stall pre-fix). Post-merge main run 31001281398 completed the same job in 56s.
